steps: Tap the fries bin to drop fries in a vat.
Tap the vat when the green tick shows.
Drag the fries to the customer.
Tap the buns, then the patty tray.
Flip the patty when asked, then put it on the burger.
Add lettuce and tomato, then drag it to the customer.
Tap the nuggets bin to drop them in a vat.
Tap the vat when the green tick shows.
Drag the nuggets to the customer.
Tap the dough to put a pizza in the oven.
Tap the oven when it is ready, before it burns.
Drag the pizza to the customer.
Tap the drinks dispenser to fill a cup.
Tap the full cup to put it on a plate.
Drag the drink to the customer.
Tap the ice cream machine to swirl a cone.
Tap the cone before it melts.
Drag the ice cream to the customer.
